name: Lettershift
thesis: Raygen’s name becomes a working mechanical assembly: six oversized letter carriages on a shared rail, with room to play.
interaction: A bounded entrance seats the lettering; a keyboard-accessible travel slider spreads and rotates its six carriages, and Seat letters returns them to alignment.
why: Acid yellow Dela Gothic lettering turns the identity itself into hardware, while actual printer imagery arrives afterward as proof of the same fascination with motion.
